'''Tigor Sims''' was an individual who worked as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While he was carrying critical datafiles for the Rebellion over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Granus IV]], his ship was shot down.
